items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 2 at 5:08AM PST until November 3 at 8:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...An increased risk for sneaker waves and strong rip
currents.

* WHERE...Pacific Coast beaches.

* WHEN...Through 8 PM Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
items.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 3 at 1:19AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
A storm system will sweep through the coastal waters Tuesday morning
through the evening resulting in hazardous weather for the
coastal waters north of Pigeon Point. Peak threat for
thunderstorms will be late Tuesday morning through Tuesday
afternoon. Developed storms will be capable of producing local
gale force wind gusts, rough seas, lightning, heavy rainfall with
reduced visibility, and waterspouts.
